summary: Tested 3 P1 security features: Security Headers, Admin Role System, and CSRF Protection. All 12 backend tests passed. Frontend login and navigation work correctly with CSRF protection enabled.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Security features fully tested. Security Headers middleware adds 7 headers (X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, X-XSS-Protection, HSTS, CSP). Admin endpoints (/api/admin/users, /api/admin/stats, /api/admin/unlock-user) require admin role. CSRF token is returned in login response body AND set as non-httponly cookie. Frontend apiFetch.js utility reads cookie and adds X-CSRF-Token header on POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE.

security_headers.details: All 7 headers present: X-Frame-Options=DENY, X-Content-Type-Options=nosniff, Referrer-Policy=strict-origin-when-cross-origin, Permissions-Policy (camera/mic/geo disabled), X-XSS-Protection=1;mode=block, HSTS max-age=31536000, CSP with frame-ancestors 'none'

csrf_protection.details: Login returns csrf_token in body, sets csrf_token cookie (non-httponly), token matches between body and cookie

admin_role_system.details: Regular user gets 403 on admin endpoints, admin user can access /api/admin/stats (returns total_users, total_jobs_indexed, etc.), /api/admin/users (paginated, no password_hash exposed), /api/admin/unlock-user works

frontend_csrf_integration.details: Login works, dashboard loads, navigation to Profile and Find Jobs works without CSRF errors
